title: How do you think one of the Rage modes I specifically added for the 12 different characters in my game turned out? Does it feel incomplete?
author: Practical_Yellow3154

comments.author: Striking_Procedure40
comments.body: What makes this unique to vampire survivors because that’s obviously the inspiration for this. I want to see some sort of mechanic that is different to vampire survivors. Maybe a skill challenge to get the rage mode?

replies.author: Practical_Yellow3154
replies.body: Unlike Vampire Survivors, what makes it unique are rage modes, different natural events, a mechanic to prevent bosses from spawning too early, an AI system that manages your game—its capabilities are massive, basically like a god—and a boss crafting system.😗

replies.author: Striking_Procedure40
replies.body: Ok bud, you asked for feedback. To me based on the video alone feels like a clone.

replies.author: Practical_Yellow3154
replies.body:
Fair point, I'll work on changing that. Thanks, I'm not the best at video editing.  
😅
